Oil dripping under the boom after a full day of digging. It still runs. Should we keep using it?
Moving it to the next site on our own trailer. Where is the slew lock?
Dented the corner of the blade on a concrete curb. Still works fine.

values.damage_description: Lens cracked. The lamp still works.

submission_data_json.description: Scuffed the paint on the counterweight against a fence post.

submission_data_json.description: Forgot to mention at drop-off: I backed into a post and dented the left fender.
Hoist stops partway up with a full load of wet soil. I shovelled some out like the page says and it lifts now, but slowly. Is the battery low?
Did the breakaway test before leaving and the brakes didn't lock when I pulled the pin. Not towing until someone checks.
Second operator on the crew wants to go over the start-up steps again. Is there a copy we can look at on a phone?
Left track came off on soft ground at the back of the lot. Machine is parked and shut down.
The coupler won't latch onto my hitch ball.

values.deck_condition: Some mud on the deck; hosed off.
